body:
Worker trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-28 01:27Z; my own slip on w-1342015d1040). A slot GO covers a run sequence only while it lasts. When a run FAILS, the coordinator may pass the slot on at once: Fable2 #3790 moved it to Sol-8e1f 3 s after my tsc FAIL. I kept fixing and relaunching without re-reading the mailbox, and six runs landed in another lane's slot. They also ran on changing inputs, so none of them counted. RULE:
(1) Re-read the coordinator mailbox before EVERY launcher run in a slot, not only the first.
(2) After any FAIL, stop: preserve the run, diagnose read-only, and mail the coordinator before any relaunch.
(3) Never edit and rerun inside a slot. A changed input needs a re-freeze and a new GO, and then all planned checks run on that ONE frozen input.
